description.value:
You channel chakra to perform jutsu through the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Cast a Spell] activity. Your jutsu use the new chakra magic tradition; your spell attack rolls and spell DCs use your key attribute (set by your specialization).

Spell slots represent your chakra capacity. The number of slots and the highest rank you can cast is set by your specialization's spell-slot progression.

Cantrip-equivalent (Basic) jutsu are non-slot-consuming jutsu you can perform at will. Each is automatically heightened to half your level (rounded up), like any other PF2e cantrip.
